verdict.rationale: Render documents fully-managed databases with point-in-time recovery, read replicas and high availability, but nothing in the evidence describes a serverless SQL offering or a way to query it from code without managing connections, such as an HTTP or serverless driver. Managed datastores are an adjacent feature, not this capability. A cloud platform could plausibly ship this, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes the verdict none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query a serverless SQL database directly from my code with no connection management
